residual_risks.detail: Python 3.11 is unavailable; only Python 3.11 grammar compatibility and Python 3.13 execution were verified.
Live Neuro WebSocket, SC2 API, Bank, and real-SC2 runtime behavior remain outside this offline stage.
The MVP uses a deterministic in-memory backend; an end-to-end run against the existing CMRE SimulatorSession is deferred until the mission adapter stage can supply a concrete Dead of Night scenario.
